subject: Insurance
title: Your Car Determines Your Rate
description: A quick, practical guide to Your Car Determines Your Rate.

hook.text: Insuring a Honda Civic costs $1,400 a year. A Tesla Model S costs $3,800.

buildup.text: Insurers consider repair costs, safety ratings, theft rates, and horsepower. Expensive-to-fix cars cost more to insure.

discovery.text: Sports cars cost more because they're driven faster. SUVs cost less per-accident because they protect occupants better.

twist.text: Electric vehicles cost 15-25% more to insure than gas equivalents. Battery replacement costs $15,000-$20,000.

climax.text: Your car is a rolling insurance calculation: repair cost, safety, theft risk.

punchline.text: Civic: $1,400. Tesla: $3,800. Your car choice is an insurance decision.

quiz.question: Why do electric vehicles cost more to insure?
